directoryStems.mcq-0763892c4fe5cc16609cece1: כשליש מהחולים הסובלים מדמנציה בשלב מתקדם מפתחים הפרעות בליעה. לפי המלצות "CHOOSING WISELY" של האיגוד הגריאטרי האמריקאי, מה היתרונות/ חסרונות של "הזנת צינור" מול הזנה פומית?
directoryStems.mcq-66840041ca1251fd06ed0353: An 82-year-old woman reports difficulty swallowing on the second day after an ischemic stroke. Which step begins the swallowing-assessment sequence described in Hazzard?
directoryStems.mcq-100775ed9eb4405b96c26b09: A 76-year-old woman with Parkinson disease is hospitalized with pneumonia and delirium. She has lost 6 kg in two months because of dysphagia. A video swallow study shows aspiration of thin liquids but safe swallowing of nectar-thick liquids. Her family requests a feeding tube. She takes carbidopa/levodopa, pramipexole, and quetiapine 50 mg at bedtime; MoCA during admission is 18/30. Which principle supports considering speech-therapy-guided, supervised thickened liquids?
directoryStems.mcq-e6deffe4211f7bcc6c702fd2: An 82-year-old man in a nursing facility for rehabilitation after a recent left middle cerebral artery stroke with residual hemiparesis develops acute confusion and agitation during dinner. Staff observed food pocketing and failure to swallow before he became aggressive when they tried to help. He has diabetes and hypertension and takes aspirin, lisinopril, metformin, and mirtazapine 15 mg at bedtime. Oxygen saturation falls to 88%, and chest radiography shows a right lower-lobe infiltrate. Which source-described relationship makes a swallowing-related pulmonary complication relevant?
directoryStems.mcq-7b70f07311595f68ed7aa9ea: גבר בן 77 סובל מדיספגיה מתקדמת למוצקים ולנוזלים וירידה במשקל. אנדוסקופיה והבירור המשלים שללו חסימה ממאירה, ומנומטריה אישרה אכלזיה. לאחר דיון בחלופות הוחלט שאינו מתאים להרחבה פנאומטית, למיוטומיה ניתוחית או ל־POEM. איזו התערבות מתאימה כעת?
directoryStems.mcq-5c335f2132c6af1f4c4e5521: An older patient with recurrent pneumonia, dysphagia and xerostomia is taking amitriptyline. Which mechanism may impair clearance of oral secretions?
directoryStems.mcq-90962a366a2b7bb60142846b: A 78-year-old man says that pills stick when he swallows. Medication review has not yet identified a particular causative drug. Which advice is consistent with Hazzard?
directoryStems.mcq-633cd3eee98ead565d0d0f25: An ambulatory acute-rehabilitation patient without cognitive impairment requires thickened liquids because of dysphagia. The swallowing team is considering a free-water protocol. Which description matches the protocols discussed in Hazzard?
directoryStems.mcq-47df7316230f41fb11829ab6: A 79-year-old man with diabetes and mild cognitive impairment has lost about 7 kg in four months. He takes small bites, chews extensively, reports food going 'the wrong way,' and has a wet, gurgly voice after meals. Medications are metformin 500 mg twice daily, glipizide 10 mg twice daily, lisinopril 20 mg daily, and atorvastatin 40 mg daily; creatinine clearance is 44 mL/min. Modified barium swallow shows vallecular residue and delayed swallow initiation. Which statement correctly characterizes rehabilitative swallowing therapy considered after this assessment?
directoryStems.mcq-abaaa7c49767178ac5886cf6: During videofluoroscopy, a patient with Parkinson disease aspirates less with honey-thick liquids. What can the team infer about pneumonia prevention over the next three months?
directoryStems.mcq-ce329094e0912a01fff7fc08: A woman with dysphagia pockets food in her cheek and chews for prolonged periods. Before selecting swallowing reminders or a texture modification, what should guide the intervention?
directoryStems.mcq-1af78560668dcce3a6adcb18: In the swallowing studies described by Hazzard, which outcome favored honey-thick liquids most clearly?
directoryStems.mcq-109fa96a0d117204c9db7536: A 79-year-old woman with moderate Alzheimer dementia has completed treatment for aspiration pneumonia but still coughs when drinking. A speech-language pathologist recommends thickened liquids and a pureed diet. Her daughter asks to preserve her usual coffee and food for enjoyment. Which discussion addresses both swallowing risk and the patient’s preferences?
directoryStems.mcq-1ef9317d38505c47a9f03c80: After a stroke, a patient has swallowing difficulty and a wet voice after drinking. No cough occurs during bedside assessment. The team wants to characterize bolus flow and test swallowing adjustments in real time. Which assessment fits this purpose?
directoryStems.mcq-4c3fda6b97055d09bfccf60c: בן 88, מתגורר בביתו עם מטפלת צמודה. ברקע: מצב אחרי אירועי מוחי, דמנציה וסקולרית, אירועי אגיטציה בתדירות יומית. בהמלצת קלינאית תקשורת מוזן בכלכלה דייסתית. נבדק בחשד לדלקת ריאות כתוצאה מאספירציה. בבדיקתו: חום 38 מעלות, היגיינת פה ירודה, חרחורים לחים בבסיס ריאה ימנית. בצילום חזה תסנין בבסיס ריאה ימנית. מה מהבאים, במטופל זה, עשוי להפחית את הסיכון להתפתחות דלקת ראות כתוצאה מאספירציה?

highlightAliases.old: In Parkinson disease/dementia trials, honey-thick fluids reduced immediate aspiration more than nectar-thick or chin-down strategies, but chin-down and thickened fluids were equally effective for pneumonia prevention over 3 months (p450).
highlightAliases.new: In Parkinson disease/dementia trials, honey-thick fluids reduced immediate aspiration more than nectar-thick or chin-down strategies, but the trial found no significant difference in pneumonia incidence between chin-down and thickened fluids over 3 months (p450; Robbins et al., PMID 18378947).
